slides.headline: He can't take his eyes off *her*.
slides.sub: James Tissot, The Captain and the Mate, 1873

slides.headline: On deck in port. Two couples, two very different *moods*.
The young mate leans in, eyes fixed on *her*.
She turns to him and holds his *gaze*.
Their hands are very close. Too *close*?
On the left, another woman looks *away*.
The bearded captain stares into space, hands *clasped*.
Wine glasses and a decanter wait on the *table*.
A red tartan shawl lies thrown on the *bench*.
Around them, the masts of a busy *harbour*.
Tissot used real sailors and friends as *models*.
He can't take his eyes off her. Would *you*?
